description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1.) Just a short question. We must follow Jesus. But did Jesus eat fish? So can we eat fish like him? 
.
2.) I was married. I divorced and remarried.
I’m now widowed. (The remarried wife is deceased).
Within the context that I’m the offending (wrong) party, is it lawful, under God, to marry the third time? Is remarrying a third time an unpardonable evil based on some popular SDA teachers?
.
3.) Hello!  I have a question.  What is the difference between the work of the Holy Spirit in the Old Testament and after the resurrection of Jesus?  
.
4.) Hello once again pastors, I’ve been wondering this for some time now and I figured that it’ll be a good question to ask. The question is, how can I better contemplate Christ and what he has done. How can I fill my mind with thoughts from above rather than fill my mind with thoughts from earth. I’ve seen many a times that I am caught up with thinking about things that don’t elevate the name of God. So, instead of thinking those things, I want to fill my mind with Christ-like thoughts.
.
Join us every Tuesday at 4:30pm (Pacific Time) for our weekly episode only on SUMtv.org! 
Additional Bible studies are available at SecretsUnsealed.org.
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program.
.
.
Visit our Website at SecretsUnsealed.org
For 24/7 streaming, visit SUMtv.org
.
